purpose: Preserve the completed read-only final harness/evidence audit; no new benchmark or verification run was performed to produce this record.

audited_harness.method: Independently recomputed SHA-256 of the current harness and compared with both published receipts.

conclusion: No new actionable correctness gap found within the inspected source and published candidate evidence.

direct_checks.check: Receipt populations and same-run full-frame repeatability
direct_checks.method: Read-only Python assertions over both published JSON receipts; not renderer execution.
direct_checks.result: Both receipts contain repeat indices 0,1,2,3 for every frame. Linear/finished array metadata and hashes, SP call count and motion-blur flag match the initial run.

direct_checks.check: SP same-run repeatability and call-input coverage
direct_checks.method: Read-only Python assertions over both published JSON receipts.
direct_checks.result: Every group contains repeats 0,1,2,3. All ten input records and RGB, depth and depth-change-mask records match the initial call.

direct_checks.check: Candidate cold versus fresh-process cache equality
direct_checks.method: Independent field-by-field JSON comparisons; did not rely solely on cache_reload_exact.
fields_checked: SP identities, input hashes, RGB, depth and masks
direct_checks.result: All inspected records agree exactly across phases. Cache receipt records one first-call SP cache hit; cold receipt records one miss and no hits.

direct_checks.result: The differing-file list is exactly the-long-dawn/shots/run/sdfppl.py.

direct_checks.method: For every preview, matched input NPY hash and float-RGB hash to its cold-receipt output record, then independently hashed the packaged PNG.
direct_checks.result: All preview source links and PNG hashes agree. Original NPY bytes were not rehashed or decoded in this audit.

direct_checks.method: Compared README claims with receipt fields; directly subtracted the original and candidate receipt creation timestamps.
direct_checks.result: Published rounded timings, one-signature reuse and cache claims match receipts. The original receipt status was starting when inspected; original comparison, original cache reload and adoption are marked pending.

code_inspection.subject: Changes since prior harness review
code_inspection.finding: Suite mode records explicit frame requests and mode identities; full-frame warm equality checks linear and finished records. Cache-reload equality also checks every full-frame record and per-call input/output records.

code_inspection.subject: Array capture and timing boundaries
code_inspection.finding: Each real SP call hashes all ten inputs before execution and captures post-call RGB, forward depth and changed-depth mask. Copy/hash/save instrumentation lies outside the recorded SP call timer. First full-frame linear and finished arrays are saved; every repeat records their hashes.

code_inspection.subject: Finish does not overwrite the captured linear input
code_inspection.finding: look.finish starts from hdr.astype(np.float32); watchers.finish delegates to that function. Inspection found no in-place modification of the input linear array in this path.

code_inspection.subject: Scope wording
code_inspection.finding: Publication labels candidate-only evidence, excludes PR8 catch changes, discloses overlapping reference compilation/load, and withholds original-output equivalence and adoption.

limitations: No renderer, JIT compilation, sampling, process control, tests or source edits were performed during this audit.
Array equality was independently checked through the captured shape/dtype/finite/hash records. The raw NPY arrays were not decoded or independently rehashed during this audit.
The review covers the named linear/finished RGB outputs and SP RGB/forward-depth/mask/input records. It does not certify every intermediate array, every frame or all-input equivalence.
The original comparison and original cache reload were pending when inspected. This audit supplies no original-versus-candidate output verdict, speedup ratio or adoption decision.
The published previews were verified by hash/provenance here; this audit did not repeat the implementing session's visual assessment.
Recorded timing fields were verified against receipts, not independently timed. Concurrent workload prevents a controlled throughput conclusion.
